title: Build the bootstrap capability ledger and reconcile prior engine beads
description:
Produce the FIRST capability inventory and the prior-bead reconciliation. This is
explicitly a BOOTSTRAP ledger, not the authoritative one (that is 19.5.12).

*** WHY THIS CANNOT BE DERIVED FROM THE PACK ***
The current pack OMITS whole clauses. A ledger generated only from its projected
mechanics inherits exactly the blind spots this audit exposed. Concretely: if
legendary-action budgets are absent from the pack, deriving requirements from the
pack cannot discover that a legendary-budget capability is needed. So the
bootstrap ledger must be assembled from FIVE sources, not one:
  1. current readiness artifacts (data.executionReadiness; the 2026-07-06
     execution-boundary and engine-coverage inventories);
  2. current code (what @eshyra/core actually implements today);
  3. current open AND closed beads;
  4. every accepted audit finding from the 2026-07-24 reviews;
  5. source clauses KNOWN to be missing from current projection (from the audit
     findings themselves — legendary budgets, point-origin geometry, multi-save
     entries, rider damage, half-damage branches, pit variants, etc.).
This bead can start immediately, before any A-epic work lands.

*** REQUIRED DELIVERABLE — the eshyra-2n1t contradiction ***
eshyra-2n1t (the "engine F1-F10" epic) was CLOSED 2026-07-21 claiming full
worktree/test/importer-reproducibility/freeze verification. Three days later the
audit finds 794 engine-pending magic-item clauses in the committed pack. Produce
a durable artifact classifying EACH old "engine complete" bead into exactly one:
  * DIFFERENT SCOPE OR TAXONOMY — correctly closed; never claimed the newly
    identified capability. (Most likely for engine:F1/F4/F8/F9/F10 given the
    taxonomy divergence.)
  * STALE READINESS MAPPING — the code exists, but readiness artifacts failed to
    recognize it.
  * INCOMPLETE INTEGRATION — a primitive exists but is not wired into the
    required execution path.
  * PREMATURE CLOSURE — the stated acceptance was objectively not satisfied.

Handling rules — PRESERVE HISTORICAL TRUTH, do not auto-reopen eshyra-2n1t:
  * Leave it closed where the scope was genuinely different.
  * Reopen the relevant old CHILD only where its stated acceptance was
    objectively unmet.
  * Otherwise create a new exact corrective child under eshyra-olc5 and link the old
    bead as historical context.
  * Add a note to the old epic linking the reconciliation result, so future
    reviewers cannot cite its closed status as proof of engine completeness.

Beads to reconcile (all currently CLOSED): eshyra-2n1t and its children,
eshyra-2n1t.1 (D1 multiclass scope -> ADR 0018), eshyra-2n1t.2 (D2
creation-variant policy), eshyra-b69j.13 (PR #311), eshyra-o9bd.18.7 and
eshyra-o9bd.18.7.8.

Baseline snapshot at 4384f25: 1,016 magic-item readiness clauses = 794
engine-pending + 218 green + 3 adjudicated-by-design + 1 design-blocked. Hook
references: engine:F1 83, F2 226, F3 31, F4 169, F5 399, F6 46, F7 15, F8 310,
F9 236, F10 9. Counts overlap because one clause may require several
capabilities.

COUNT HYGIENE: every number in this bead is a SNAPSHOT at commit 4384f25. The
generated ledger/predicate is authoritative. No acceptance test may require a
hand-copied number (e.g. 391, 399, 77, 79).

CANONICAL ALIAS PREFIXES — use these everywhere; never a bare "F1" or "CAP-001":
  engine:F1 .. engine:F10     pack executionReadiness engineHooks[].engine families
  fable:F1 .. fable:F8        Fable 5 audit findings
  opus:F-01 .. opus:F-35      Opus 5 original + amended audit findings
  sol:CAP-001 .. sol:CAP-014  GPT-5.6-Sol agent audit findings
  indep:001 .. indep:012      independent review (formerly "SOL-001..012"; renamed
                              so it stops colliding with the sol: model-name prefix)

## REVIEW CONTRACT

Protocol: eshyra-clause-review-v1

Migration baseline recorded 2026-07-26 during the final pre-protocol review
cycle. Derived from the corrected design at commit dee8d0a.

### Source obligation
- Source membership: 31 primitive rows spanning engine:F1..F10, each naming one
  implementation primitive rather than a family label.
- Membership derivation: the five bootstrap sources, each with its OWN
  executable resolver — readiness artifacts, @eshyra/core code, open and closed
  beads, accepted 2026-07-24 findings, and source clauses known missing from
  projection. A ledger derived from the pack alone inherits the pack's blind
  spots.
- Source spans or authoritative inputs: evidence is a discriminated union keyed
  by kind — 'readiness-artifact', 'code', 'bead', 'audit-finding',
  'known-missing-source-clause'. sourceSpan is NOT overloaded to carry
  incompatible evidence types.
- Complete obligations covered: bootstrap scope only. This ledger is explicitly
  NON-AUTHORITATIVE; eshyra-o9bd.19.5.12 regenerates the authoritative ledger
  from the clause-complete corpus and diffs against this one.

### Pack or artifact representation
- Required semantic distinctions: primitive identity, never family membership.
  Family grouping may organise rows but can never substitute for primitive
  identity or exact affected membership.
- Branches and alternatives: hook selection uses exact structured hook identity.
  Unconstrained substring matching is rejected, with negative tests for
  near-matches, prefixes, suffixes and unrelated strings sharing a token.
- Timing, lifecycle, and termination: carried by the individual primitives —
  planar-return and declared-window clocks, item-instance persistence,
  hit-point and death lifecycle.
- Provenance and ownership requirements: every row names an owning bead. An
  'owned' row may never name the engine epic root eshyra-olc5; a
  'proposed-new-bead' row may, and carries a proposed title and parent.

### Cross-kind and cross-surface checks
- Related kinds or subsystems: engine:F1..F10 plus the four cross-family
  primitive beads eshyra-o9bd.19.5.5.3, .19.5.6.3, .19.5.8.3 and .19.5.11.3.
- Corpus-wide predicates or reconciliation: 2n1t-engine-closure-reconciliation.md
  classifies eshyra-2n1t and all thirteen children plus eshyra-b69j.13,
  eshyra-o9bd.18.7 and .18.7.8. The epic itself is PREMATURE / OVERSTATED
  UMBRELLA CLOSURE; eight children are INCOMPLETE INTEGRATION. Corrective
  ownership routes .6, .7, .9 and .12 to the four new beads.

### Engine capability
- Required capabilities: all ten engine:F* families, at primitive granularity,
  several rows per family.
- Existing owner beads: the ten family epics under eshyra-olc5 own rows that fit
  a family; the four cross-family beads own the rest.
- Known missing capability handling: 'known-missing-source-clause' evidence must
  POSITIVELY PROVE absence from the pack. An empty query result is never
  accepted as proof.

### Reference execution or executable proof
- Real artifact or pack-driven scenarios: readiness-artifact evidence executes
  against the committed pack; code evidence proves the named symbol exists in
  @eshyra/core; bead evidence resolves through bd.
- Negative and fail-closed scenarios: unknown, duplicate, ambiguous, untraceable
  or missing query bindings are rejected; near-match hook identities are
  rejected; recursive stored-count/total fields are rejected at any depth;
  unexpectedly empty results fail per evidence kind.
- Replay, rollback, or determinism requirements: bd resolution SKIPS GRACEFULLY
  when the binary is absent, so the suite never depends on bd being installed.

### Approved residuals
- Source ambiguities: none owned here.
- Deliberately model-adjudicated boundaries: none owned here.
- Explicitly unsupported scope: implementing any engine capability. This bead
  inventories and reconciles; implementation belongs to the decomposition and
  certification tasks under eshyra-olc5.

### Closure evidence
- Generated membership query: per-row query identities resolved through the
  per-source evidence resolvers.
- Permanent regression evidence:
  packages/core/test/bootstrapCapabilityLedger.test.ts — exact structured hook
  identity, proof-of-absence, query-binding rejection, the pinned seven non-pack
  primitives, proposed-row representability, and rejection of the old overloaded
  pack evidence.
- Finding-registry aliases: sol:CAP-007, sol:CAP-014.

### Material contract changes in this cycle
1. Evidence became a per-source discriminated union with per-kind resolvers and
   per-kind expected-result semantics. Reason: the sole evaluator read
   data.executionReadiness, which exists on MAGIC-ITEM RECORDS ONLY, so every
   row across all ten families was proved by an evaluator that could not see its
   subject matter.
2. Exact structured hook identity replaced substring matching. Reason:
   text.includes() assigns hooks to the wrong primitive on near-matches.
3. Empty results must be positively justified per evidence kind. Reason: absence
   of evidence was passing as evidence of absence.
4. Rows bind to named query identities; positional or family association is
   rejected. Reason: results could not be traced back to their row.
5. eshyra-2n1t reclassified as premature/overstated umbrella closure. Reason:
   the closing PR claimed executable mechanics for all 240 magic items and zero
   deep-audit findings; narrow child acceptance does not validate a global
   claim later proven false.

Prior review approval does NOT survive these changes. A fresh full review is
required.

### Invariant classes added 2026-07-26 (contract-grounded review at dee8d0a)

- **CANONICAL PRIMITIVE ROSTER.** A committed, versioned roster of
  (capabilityId, primitive); the validator asserts exact set equality. Missing
  and unexpected rows both fail, tested both directions. Adding a primitive now
  requires deliberately editing the roster.
- **AUDIT-FINDING EVIDENCE MUST BE RELEVANT, NOT MERELY RESOLVABLE.** A committed
  alias-to-subject table grounds each citation, and every audit-finding evidence
  item carries a per-row relevance statement that may not be constant or
  derivable from the primitive name. The prior head cited indep:001..012
  round-robin (histogram 3,3,3,3,3,3,3,2,2,2,2,2); citations that no finding
  supports are now dropped rather than invented.
- **KNOWN-MISSING CLAUSES PROVE REAL ABSENCE.** A known-missing row names a REAL
  source anchor and proves both that the source material exists there and that
  no pack record or clause projects it. Synthetic `SRD5.1:<primitive>` markers
  are gone. Rows without a real anchor carry evidence-underived status that
  fails the closure predicate.
- **OWNERSHIP IS EVIDENCE-BACKED.** Every owned row's owningBead must appear as a
  resolving bead-evidence entry on that row; syntax alone is insufficient.
- **QUERY BINDING IS UNIQUE WITHIN A ROW** as well as across rows.
- **OBLIGATION IDENTITY IS STRUCTURALLY VALIDATED** as
  `obl:::<sourceRef>:::<locator>:::<facet>` with four non-empty segments. The
  prior head emitted `obl:::` with empty sourceRef and locator, which silently
  broke the cross-PR join.

### Cross-PR integration boundary — actual state

This ledger's obligationId shape matches PR #475 at head 8c027f1, so the two are
mechanically joinable. PR #476 does not yet participate; eshyra-o9bd.19.1.7 owns
bridging it.

### Withdrawn by the reviewer under this contract — do not re-litigate
Code evidence proving an exported symbol exists; graceful bd skipping when the
binary is absent; absence of full pack-driven engine scenarios in this bead; the
historical reconciliation classifications.

### Invariant classes added 2026-07-27 (review at 71d4eed)

- **OBLIGATION AND EVIDENCE NAMESPACES ARE SEPARATE.** The prior head minted
  `obl:::` — which denotes a SOURCE OBLIGATION — for evidence items such as
  readiness-hook, code-symbol, ownership and primitive-relevance. That was a
  category error, not a validation gap. Now `obl:::` is used only for genuine
  source obligations carrying a CANONICAL SemanticFacet, and evidence items use a
  distinct `ev:::` namespace that PR #475 is never asked to join. Current
  state: 12 obl identities (the known-missing source obligations), 112 ev
  identities, zero duplicates registry-wide.
- **THE FACET VOCABULARY IS PINNED AND GUARDED.** CANONICAL_SEMANTIC_FACETS is
  committed locally and a test pins it, so divergence from PR #475's vocabulary
  is caught rather than discovered at integration. Widening #475's vocabulary to
  admit 'code-symbol' was explicitly rejected as the wrong fix.
- **IDENTITY COMPONENTS BIND TO THEIR OWN EVIDENCE**, and duplicates are rejected
  registry-wide rather than per row. The indep:001/sol:CAP-002 mismatch, the
  shared bead-obligation reuse, and the duplicated Aboleth projection-absence
  identity are corrected.
- **AUDIT CITATIONS MUST BE SUPPORTED BY THE FINDING'S OWN SCOPE.** Five
  confirmed unsupported mappings were DROPPED rather than reworded — spellbook
  copying to '221 magic items blocked by engine', short-rest Hit Dice to Natural
  Recovery, derived modifiers to damage field naming, currency mutation to
  Tack/Harness taxonomy, and downtime to '221 magic items'. A row may stand on
  readiness/code/bead evidence alone.
- **QUERY ID UNIQUENESS COVERS ALL QUERY-BEARING EVIDENCE KINDS** within a row,
  not readiness alone.
- **KNOWN-MISSING ROWS ANCHOR TO SPECIFIC UNPROJECTED MATERIAL** and use positive
  source-anchor checks with fail-closed handling of partial projection. Rows that
  cannot establish absence of an equivalent or partial representation are
  evidence-underived and block the closure predicate.

*** CORRECTION 2026-07-25 — 2n1t UMBRELLA CLOSURE WAS OVERSTATED ***
This bead's description offers four classifications. PR #477 review established
that they are insufficient for the EPIC itself, and the correction is accepted.

Evidence: the PR that closed eshyra-2n1t was titled "Complete SRD audit and
engine gaps", claimed source-grounded executable mechanics for all 240 magic
items, reported zero deep-audit findings, and named eshyra-2n1t and
eshyra-o9bd.18 as its beads. Three days later the audit found partial
projections mistaken for complete executable inputs, including legendary actions
with no budget or cost.

Narrow child beads may still be correctly closed because their specific
primitives landed. That does NOT validate the umbrella completeness claim. The
reconciliation must distinguish:
  * narrow child acceptance genuinely completed;
  * broader integration not completed;
  * umbrella epic closed on a GLOBAL claim later proven false.
eshyra-2n1t itself is a premature / overstated umbrella closure, or an
equivalent explicit category. eshyra-o9bd.18.7 also needs reconsideration:
omitted or silently partially projected source clauses are importer/compiler
completeness defects, not merely downstream engine work.

Reviewer confirmed NO new defect class: the three P1 and one P2 are incomplete
resolutions of existing contract invariants, so the churn rule does not yet
require rescoping. Dispatch eshyra-o9bd.19.5.1.6 is the LAST permitted local
round before the stop rule applies here too.

Accepted as fixed: the exact 31-row roster; owner-to-bead-evidence binding;
readiness query ID uniqueness within a row; real record/source/page anchors
replacing synthetic sentinels.

SUPERVISOR DECISION on the identity incompatibility: it is a CATEGORY ERROR, not
a validation gap. 'obl:::' denotes a SOURCE OBLIGATION, but this ledger mints it
for evidence items — readiness-hook, code-symbol, ownership, primitive-relevance.
The fix is to restrict obl::: to genuine source obligations with canonical
SemanticFacets matching PR #475 (guarded by a parity test), and to mint evidence
identities in a separate namespace. Widening #475's facet vocabulary to admit
'code-symbol' would have been the wrong fix.

Invalidated PR: #477      Final head: 241228ebe9e652b66cb2767374d3e3dc51340075
This bead is NOT successfully completed. It is superseded and retained for
history and salvage.

NEW DEFECT CLASSES DISCOVERED, in order:
  r1  the sole evaluator read data.executionReadiness, which exists on
      MAGIC-ITEM RECORDS ONLY, while reporting scannedRecords = records.length
  r2  unconstrained substring matching assigned hooks to the wrong primitive
  r3  audit findings "resolved" by alias existence — indep:001..012 cycled
      round-robin across 31 unrelated primitives
  r4  known-missing evidence searched the pack for LOCALLY INVENTED marker
      strings, so absence of a made-up token stood for semantic absence
  r5  owningBead checked only for ID syntax, never against bead evidence
  r6  obl::: minted for evidence items that are not source obligations at all
  r7  closure was fail-open for underived evidence
  r8  projection matching ran only on the anchor record
  r9  projectionNodes emitted only objects — scalars, primitive array elements
      and the root data object were invisible
  r10 shape recognition was heuristic alias substring matching over an open
      schema, so absence was concluded from failure to recognise

ASSUMPTIONS DISPROVEN:
  * that positive absence can be established by enumeration when RulesRecord.data
    is typed unknown and unregistered fields are not rejected;
  * that presence of an exported symbol evidences a capability;
  * that bead existence evidences contract ownership;
  * that a ledger may invent its own obligation identity and still join others.

POTENTIALLY SALVAGEABLE AS-IS: the corrected historical eshyra-2n1t
reconciliation and the distinction between narrow child completion and
overstated umbrella closure — accepted by review and independent of the
invalidated evidence framework. EXTRACT IT so it does not die with the ledger.
SALVAGE AFTER EXTRACTION: candidate capability primitive names; ownership
candidates; the evidence-strength vocabulary; the identification of primitives
invisible from current pack projection.

REPLACE: audit-alias cycling; invented sentinel-absence evidence;
exported-symbol existence as capability evidence; bead-existence as exact
contract ownership; any resolver claiming more than its evidence proves.

WHY LOCAL PATCHING STOPPED: each round produced a NEW defect class after a
material contract change and a fresh full review. The shared root cause was not
implementation quality — unsettled concepts were GENERALIZED ACROSS THE CORPUS
before their trust boundaries were proven by a small number of concrete
source-to-execution examples. Successor work inverts that order: prove the
boundary on five real procedures first (eshyra-o9bd.19.1.14), generalize after.

SUCCESSOR STRUCTURE
  F1 eshyra-o9bd.19.1.14  source-obligation identity and discharge proof
  F2 eshyra-o9bd.19.1.15  truthful audit-fact registry, no membership claims
  F3 eshyra-o9bd.19.1.7 + eshyra-o9bd.19.1.8  exact finding membership (reused)
  F4 eshyra-o9bd.19.1.16  capability evidence semantics
  F5 eshyra-olc5.5        bootstrap capability inventory rebuild

THE BRANCH IS RETAINED as historical and salvage evidence. It must not be merged
and must not be treated as an accepted contract by any downstream bead.
